lat: chre7t d-ders l sa7bi l-bare7
en: I explained the lesson to my friend yesterday.

lat: ma chre7tch l-fikra mzyan l khuya
en: I didn't explain the idea well to my brother.

lat: nta chre7ti l-qadya l l-mudir
en: You explained the case to the director.

lat: ma chre7tich had l-klma l bak
en: You didn't explain this word to your father.

lat: nti chre7ti l-muchkila l khtek
en: You explained the problem to your sister.

lat: ma chre7tich l-qawa3id l s-sa7ba dyalk
en: You didn't explain the rules to your friend.

lat: l-mu3ellim chre7 t-temrin l t-tlamed
en: The teacher explained the exercise to the students.

lat: huwa ma chre7ch l-khedma dyalu mzyan
ar: هو ما شرحش الخدمة ديالو مزيان
en: He didn't explain his work well.

lat: l-ustada cher7at d-ders l-yum
en: The teacher explained the lesson today.

lat: hiya ma cher7atch l-mawdu3 l l-walidin
en: She didn't explain the topic to the parents.

lat: chre7na l-khuta l l-ferqa dyalna
en: We explained the plan to our team.

lat: ma chre7nach l-machru3 l n-nas
en: We didn't explain the project to the people.

lat: ntuma chre7tu kulchi f l-ijtima3
en: You explained everything in the meeting.

lat: ma chre7tuch s-sabab l l-bolis
en: You didn't explain the reason to the police.

lat: l-asatida cher7u l-mti7an l t-tullab
en: The professors explained the exam to the students.

lat: huma ma cher7uch l-waqi3a l l-jiran
en: They didn't explain the incident to the neighbors.

lat: ana dima kanchre7 l-qanun l n-nas
en: I always explain the law to the people.

lat: ma kanchre7ch had d-ders b z-zerba
en: I don't explain this lesson in a hurry.

lat: nta katchre7 b chwiya f l-qism
en: You explain slowly in the classroom.

lat: ma katchre7ch l-fikra dyalk b wudu7
en: You don't explain your idea clearly.

lat: nti katcher7i mzyan l l-bent
en: You explain well to the girl.

lat: ma katcher7ich s-sirr dyalk l 7ed
en: You don't explain your secret to anyone.

lat: t-tbib kaychre7 l-merd l l-marid
en: The doctor explains the illness to the patient.

lat: huwa ma kaychre7ch t-tariqa dyalu l l-khdama
ar: هو ما كيشرحش الطريقة ديالو للخدامة
en: He doesn't explain his method to the workers.

lat: l-mu3ellima katchre7 l-qawa3id kul nhar
en: The teacher explains the rules every day.

lat: hiya ma katchre7ch l-klma l-jdida l l-wlad
ar: هي ما كتشرحش الكلمة الجديدة للولاد
en: She doesn't explain the new word to the kids.

lat: 7na kancher7u l-barnamaj l l-muwaddafin
en: We explain the program to the employees.

lat: ma kancher7uch had l-mawdu3 daba
en: We don't explain this topic now.

lat: ntuma katcher7u l-7el l l-muchkila
en: You explain the solution to the problem.

lat: ma katcher7uch l-asbab dyalkum l n-nas
en: You don't explain your reasons to the people.

lat: l-muhandisin kaycher7u t-tasmim mzyan
en: The engineers explain the design well.

lat: huma ma kaycher7uch l-qarar dyalhum l l-jami3
ar: هما ما كيشرحوش القرار ديالهم للجميع
en: They don't explain their decision to everyone.

lat: ghadi nchre7 l-ghalat dyali l l-mudira
en: I'm going to explain my mistake to the principal.

lat: ma ghadich nchre7 had l-amr l 7ed
ar: ما غاديش نشرح هاد الأمر لحد
en: I'm not going to explain this matter to anyone.

lat: nta ghadi tchre7 t-tariqa l khuya
en: You are going to explain the method to my brother.

lat: ma ghadich tchre7 l-mawdu3 f t-tilfaza
en: You are not going to explain the topic on TV.

lat: nti ghadi tcher7i l-muchkil l bak
en: You are going to explain the problem to your father.

lat: ma ghadich tcher7i l-qisa kamla l-yum
ar: ما غاديش تشرحي القصة كاملة اليوم
en: You are not going to explain the whole story today.

lat: huwa ghadi ychre7 l-machru3 f l-ijtima3
en: He is going to explain the project in the meeting.

lat: ma ghadich ychre7 s-sabab l l-ustad
en: He is not going to explain the reason to the teacher.

lat: hiya ghadi tchre7 l-fikra l l-ferqa
en: She is going to explain the idea to the team.

lat: ma ghadich tchre7 t-tafasil l n-nas
en: She is not going to explain the details to the people.

lat: 7na ghadi ncher7u d-ders l t-tlamed
en: We are going to explain the lesson to the students.

lat: ma ghadich ncher7u l-qadya daba
en: We are not going to explain the case now.

lat: ntuma ghadi tcher7u l-khuta l l-mudir
en: You are going to explain the plan to the director.

lat: ma ghadich tcher7u l-barnamaj f r-radyu
en: You are not going to explain the program on the radio.

lat: huma ghadi ycher7u l-wad3iya l l-jiran
en: They are going to explain the situation to the neighbors.

lat: ma ghadich ycher7u l-qarar dyalhum ghda
ar: ما غاديش يشرحو القرار ديالهم غدا
en: They are not going to explain their decision tomorrow.
